thread: rachel: quick question — thinking about adaptive axis units for latency charts in dashboards. small multiples flip between ms/s and it looks inconsistent. current behavior is auto-scale per chart. mica: i vote for a consistent unit per dashboard. auto-scaling across tiny facets is confusing at a glance. tom: could we have dynamic units but show a tiny unit indicator in the top-right of the axis that is clickable? clicking gives option to lock unit for that dashboard. elaine: accessibility note: if that unit indicator is interactive it must be keyboard focusable and have aria-describedby to a hidden explanation. screen readers should hear "Latency, 1.2 seconds" not "one point two s". rachel: Draft tooltip copy: "Units auto-scale for readability. Click to lock units for this chart." mica: tweak: "Lock units for this dashboard" — clearer for multi-chart pages. tom: second topic: outliers. right now charts scale to max value which flattens trends. options: (a) clip outliers + show an overflow indicator, (b) expose log scale toggle, (c) show an inset zoom for large points. which should be default? elaine: default = clip with overflow marker. log scale is surprising for many users. but expose log and inset as advanced options. rachel: UX idea: a small badge on the y-axis when clipping occurs: "3 clipped" (click opens modal listing raw points and actions: apply log / show inset / adjust max). mica: design nit — use a clear label, not just emoji. badge must be high-contrast and use aria-label "3 values clipped" for screen readers. elaine: sample markup (visually-hidden span for SR): ```html ⚠️ 3 clipped 3 data points clipped above chart max ``` tom: smoothing controls: lots of folks miss the tooltip toggle. propose moving smoothing into the chart actions menu (ellipsis) and adding a tiny slider for "smoothing strength" (0-100) which persists per dashboard. rachel: copy for slider: "Smoothing: 40 (0=none, 100=heavy)" mica: add keyboard shortcuts: `s` to toggle smoothing, `Shift+S` to open slider. need accessibility sign-off before shipping. elaine: accessibility requirement: when smoothing is toggled or strength changes, write to an aria-live region: "Smoothing applied, strength 40" so assistive tech is aware of the visual change. rachel: additional axis copy suggestion: use format "Latency (p50) — ms" or "Latency (p50) — s" and provide a tooltip on the axis label that expands the full meaning (p50 = median). tom: implementation note: when a dashboard locks units, store preference in the dashboard settings and expose in the shareable link/state. rachel: summary of action items: 1) unit indicator in axis corner + tooltip + "lock units for dashboard" action; 2) default outlier behavior = clip + "X clipped" badge (aria-labelled) + modal with options (log/inset/adjust); 3) move smoothing into actions menu + micro-slider (0-100) + keyboard shortcuts + aria-live updates; 4) standardize axis label copy to show metric + unit + pXX when applicable; 5) design mock and accessibility spec needed. assignments: @mica -> badge & unit UI mock, @tom -> slider spec & keyboard RFC, @elaine -> aria examples + sr-only helper PR, @rachel -> coordinates and final copy. design-bot: created card DW-4310 — "Axis units, outlier clipping badge, smoothing UX & accessibility" https://kanban.redwood/DW-4310 ✅ mica: i'll start on the mock today and will ping for review. tom: i'll open a small RFC for keyboard handling and the dashboard lock state. elaine: i'll draft the aria snippets and post a tiny PR for the sr-only CSS helper. rachel: thanks team — this should make tiny multiples way easier to scan :rocket:
